verdicts.reason: Both shrink the crowd illustration to a thin strip that crops off heads at the top, so the imagery that defined the original becomes a minor header. Both also blow the quote up into a nine-line block with short, choppy lines. In A the quote's line spacing is tighter and there is a clear gap before the red attribution, though the top margin (about 25px) is thinner than the bottom one. In B the line spacing is looser and the attribution sits only one line-gap below the quote, so it reads like another line of the quote rather than a separate credit, which weakens the hierarchy.
